UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET created_at = COALESCE(r.created_at, s.c) FROM (SELECT i.repo_id, MIN(i.created_at) AS c FROM aveloxis_data.repo_info i GROUP BY i.repo_id) s WHERE s.repo_id = r.repo_id
